title: CI Reliability & Failure Analysis
subtitle: Platform/DevOps view of CI failure rate, where failures concentrate, why builds fail, aborted and expired runs, and how quickly pipelines recover.

widget.title: Build Failure Rate

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| aggregate { round(100.0 * count(case when pe.status = "FAILED" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as failure_rate_pct }

widget.subtitle: Share of CI executions ending FAILED

widget.title: Failures by Repository

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| filter pe.moduleinfo_repository is not null and pe.moduleinfo_repository != 'NA' and pe.moduleinfo_repository != ''
| aggregate {
    pe.moduleinfo_repository as repository,
    count(case when pe.status = "FAILED" then 1 end) as failed,
    round(100.0 * count(case when pe.status = "FAILED" then 1 end) / nullif(count(), 0), 1) as failure_rate_pct
  }
| group_by repository
| having failed > 0
| order_by failed desc
| limit 10

widget.subtitle: Repositories with the most failed builds

widget.title: Failed Steps by Step Type

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:step_execution_failure" f | inner join view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe on pe.planexecutionid = f.plan_execution_id
| filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| filter f.step_type != "liteEngineTask"
| aggregate { f.step_type as step_type, count() as failures }
| group_by step_type
| order_by failures desc
| limit 8

widget.subtitle: Which CI step types fail most (Run, Plugin, Test...)

widget.title: Top Failing Pipelines
widget.subtitle: Pipelines ranked by failed builds, with their most recent status

widget.title: Top Step Failure Messages

queries.query:
find view "view:pipeline:step_execution_failure" f | inner join view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe on pe.planexecutionid = f.plan_execution_id
| filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| filter f.failure_message is not null and f.failure_message != '""'
| aggregate {
    f.step_type as step_type,
    f.failure_message as failure_message,
    count() as occurrences,
    distinct_count(pe.pipelineidentifier) as pipelines_affected
  }
| group_by step_type, failure_message
| order_by occurrences desc
| limit 25

widget.subtitle: Most frequent step-level error messages in CI runs

widget.subtitle: Interrupted runs: user aborts vs approval/input timeouts

widget.title: Recent Unsuccessful Builds

queries.query:
find view "ci:pipeline_execution_summary_ci" pe | filter pe.startts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and pe.startts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | filter ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${repository_filter_predicate}
| filter pe.status in ["FAILED", "ABORTED", "EXPIRED"]
| select {
    pe.startts as started,
    pe.status as status,
    pe.projectidentifier as project,
    pe.pipelineidentifier as pipeline,
    pe.moduleinfo_repository as repository,
    pe.moduleinfo_branch_name as branch,
    round(pe.build_duration / 60000.0, 1) as minutes,
    pe.errormessage as error_message
  }
| order_by started desc
| limit 50

widget.subtitle: Latest failed, aborted and expired executions with error details
